proposedChanges: Separate top-level consumer products from configurable toppings/components and remove Nutritionix internal-only presentations.
Replace numeric variant-group IDs with meaningful configurable product relationships.
Collapse repeated menu/API presentations while preserving legitimate product and component allergen disclosures.
Refresh the shared DC-metro catalog against the current official menu and location ordering surface.

findings.summary: The 83-row baseline mixes consumer products, configurable components, numeric API group IDs, and internal-only calculator presentations.
The officially linked Nutritionix calculator provides current direct positive allergen evidence; omissions are not treated as negative claims.
The packet DC-metro chain scope is supported by multiple active official Washington locations sharing the menu.
